rules.outliers: Outside Q1-3*IQR or Q3+3*IQR; linear-interpolated quartiles; minimum 20 observations; zero-IQR groups not assessed
rules.grouping: Money and units within Product ID; lead-time intervals within Ship Mode; distance within country
rules.outlier_handling: Primary cleaned data retains flagged rows; separate filtered dataset is for sensitivity comparisons, not default business totals
rules.dates: Actual calendar-day Ship Date minus Order Date; screen intervals below 0 or above 60 days; never subtract an assumed offset
rules.missing: Missing required inputs are quarantined without imputation; geography blanks remain unavailable
rules.duplicates: Remove exact duplicate occurrences only; quarantine conflicting Row IDs; retain repeated Order IDs
